integrity: The field inconsistency is proved directly from the printed quartic relation. The replacement quartic is checked irreducible over \(\mathbb F_7\), \(\alpha^2=-1\) is verified exactly, and all \(2402\) projective message lines are exhaustively enumerated. The projective counts are also derived independently from an exact relation-incidence argument.
scientific_limitations: The result repairs and classifies the finite benchmark of Example 4.25. It does not modify the source's general theorems and does not classify codewords up to automorphism.
title: Correction and complete rank spectrum of the \(\mathbb F_{7^4}\) \(M\)-cyclic benchmark
